title: XDrip+ unavaliable on Google Play Store
body:
Hello,

comments.body: Oh my bad I'm sorry, the XDrip+ was in the PlayStore but in the section "Applis on the phone". Sorry for the disturbance and again a great great thanks to your great work. Is there a way to help you materially? ;)
